_note: Frozen baseline for the SHIPPED starter corpus, measured on a fresh install, so that a change to a starter rule's description cannot quietly break retrieval. If a run differs, fix the corpus or the query — never edit this file to make a run green. Note what the numbers say: literal matching passes 8 of 12 and expansion passes all 12, which is the measured value of the recall command's query-expansion step.

delivery._note: A fresh install must DELIVER its index, not merely retrieve well from it. The scores above describe a corpus the model may never have received; past an undocumented size ceiling the harness swaps the payload for a file preview and reports no error.
